ideas.pitch: An autonomous multi-agent system that ingests smart campus maintenance requests, plans repair steps, assigns tools/contractors, and resolves multi-step issues automatically.
ideas.problem_statement: Digital Twins & Predictive Intelligence and Agentic AI tracks: Building smart campus solutions using autonomous AI agents.
ideas.title: Agentic Campus Incident & Ticket Dispatcher
ideas.why_it_could_win: Directly hits the Agentic AI track with a clear, multi-step agentic workflow and execution plan that stands out to judges looking for actual reasoning loops rather than wrappers.

ideas.pitch: A real-time disaster management and prediction platform utilizing live sensor feeds to build a digital representation of urban flood risks.
ideas.problem_statement: Digital Twins & Predictive Intelligence: Create digital representations of real-world systems that use data to monitor conditions and predict disaster management outcomes.
ideas.title: FloodWatch Digital Twin
ideas.why_it_could_win: Combines predictive intelligence with a proven real-time disaster management format, appealing to judges who value clear measurable social impact.

ideas.pitch: A localized voice-first and multilingual AI agent platform for rural communities providing instant preventive care info and automated vaccine scheduling.
ideas.problem_statement: Agentic AI: Build autonomous AI agents or intelligent assistants capable of reasoning and completing multi-step tasks for community healthcare.
ideas.title: RuralMed Multilingual Health Awareness Agent
ideas.why_it_could_win: Adapts the proven structure of successful multilingual health assistants to an agentic execution model, matching high-impact social needs.

ideas.pitch: A simulation and monitoring platform for smart city logistics that tracks vehicle fleets, computes carbon output, and predicts optimal routing during gridlock.
ideas.problem_statement: Digital Twins & Predictive Intelligence: Create digital representations of real-world systems focusing on logistics and transportation.
ideas.title: Logistics Carbon & Traffic Digital Twin
ideas.why_it_could_win: Addresses the specific sub-theme of logistics and transportation in the Digital Twins track with a clean, demonstrable simulation interface.

ideas.pitch: An agentic compliance assistant that constructs transaction networks, runs graph intelligence algorithms, and explains high-risk multi-step financial flows.
ideas.problem_statement: Agentic AI: Build autonomous AI agents and intelligent multi-step assistants capable of reasoning, planning, and using tools.
ideas.title: Autonomous AML & Risk Graph Investigator
ideas.why_it_could_win: Leverages heavy technical patterns like graph intelligence and explainable outputs which score well among technical judges evaluating hard engineering.
